meta.spec: docs/swing-model-v3.md (the swing family, §6.7, PLAN D27; fitted at the measured stance, PLAN D28)
meta.rate_shape_scale: A1s = A1 cos(E_c) / cos(E4_contact): the rate shape on the horizontal contact rate
meta.elevation: B(u) = 39 deg + (e(t4) - e(-93 ms)) + dE smoothstep((u - u93)/(uw - u93)), dE = E_c - (39 deg + e(0) - e(-93 ms))

family.template_time: T_t = (A_c - A_L,t) / (Adot_c h_scale(E_c) I_hat), the template batter at the aim
family.travel: lambda = (BatSpeed / v_template)(T_b / T_mean) (x T / T_nominal after a re-plan)
family.hands_travel: lambda_W = lambda min(1, 1.10 / lambda_nominal); the launch hands min(lambda_nominal, 1)

basis.elevation_blend: E = (1 - w) B + w V on [uw, 0], w = 10x^3 - 15x^4 + 6x^5, x = (u - uw)/(-uw); V = v2 elevation

meta.note: Angles in degrees where named _deg, else radians; positions m; times s unless _ms; sim frame.

hand_case.inputs: S = (0,0,0) (O shifted down), upright trunk facing +x, rear arm θ 90° φ −90°, κ 90°, χ 270°, bat A −90° E 45°
